events.boundary: A Sunday in January 2022: Kieran asks and Laura leaves it to him.
events.region: Old Swindon: the rented flat above a shop on Wood Street
provenance: rabbit-hole-run; authored by the calling LLM under the human's delegation
events.description: At the kitchen table, with the rota on the fridge behind her, he says he wants to move the deposit somewhere it will earn twenty percent before they buy in the summer. She is marking dates on the calendar and does not look up for long. You're the one who knows about money, she says. Do what you think. He does not explain what a stablecoin is, and she does not ask. By the end of the week the twenty-four thousand pounds is in the savings protocol.

events.boundary: The February 2022 walk: Barbara says it is his choice and nothing more.
events.region: Avebury Trusloe and the Ridgeway, Wiltshire
provenance: rabbit-hole-run; authored by the calling LLM under the human's delegation
events.description: Barbara stops on the track above the long barrow, looks at the barrow for a while, and says: that's yours and Laura's to decide. She says nothing else about it all afternoon. She talks about the men who dragged the stones and about the dog. On the drive home she thinks of three sentences she could have said and says none of them, because she has never been anybody's mother and does not mean to start.

events.region: Old Swindon: the rented flat above a shop on Wood Street
provenance: rabbit-hole-run; authored by the calling LLM under the human's delegation
events.description: Four nights at the spare-room desk with the Sharehouse open on one screen and the price on the other. He reads the mechanism again and understands exactly why a run feeds itself. He does not sell at ninety cents, or sixty, or twenty. Laura is on nights; the rota says so. By Friday the deposit is worth about three thousand pounds and falling.

events.boundary: Kieran's state on 14 May 2022, the morning after.
events.region: Old Swindon: the rented flat above a shop on Wood Street
provenance: rabbit-hole-run; authored by the calling LLM under the human's delegation
events.description: The deposit is worth about three thousand pounds and still falling; his own stake is down more than ninety percent from November. He has not slept properly for a week. All that week at the Hart he has taken calls from customers who lost their savings, in the voice he used on Barbara. The Sharehouse has gone from certainty to jokes. Laura does not know; the next thing she will look at is a mortgage appointment in June. He feels the old band's shame of having led people wrong, although he led nobody, and the child's wish to be no trouble.
